items.name: kit-parts
items.title: Kit parts
items.description: The desk kit's shared modelling parts: finishes, boxes, struts, rounded slabs, keycap shapes and their legends' atlas.

items.name: desk
items.title: Sit-stand desk
items.description: A sit-stand desk sized like the FlexiSpot E7 frame: its top, columns, feet and rails, every size and finish an option.

items.name: monitor
items.title: Monitor
items.description: A monitor whose panel is a named screen for screen(): the Dell UltraSharp U2723QE (27-inch 4K) by default; presets after the Dell E2425H (24-inch), the Dell U3423WE (34-inch curved ultrawide), the ASUS ROG Strix XG27AQ (27-inch gaming) and the Apple Studio Display (27-inch 5K on its tilt stand), and a light bar after the BenQ ScreenBar Pro.

items.name: laptop
items.title: Laptop
items.description: A laptop with its keys and their legends, its lid at any angle, its display a named screen: the MacBook Pro 14 (M4, space black) by default, or silver; presets after the MacBook Pro 16, the MacBook Air 13 and 15 (midnight, starlight, silver, space grey), the ThinkPad T14 Gen 5 (TrackPoint, PC layout) and the Lenovo Legion Pro 7 16 (RGB keys, number pad), each with its own key layout.

items.name: keyboard
items.title: Mechanical keyboard
items.description: A keyboard with its keycaps and legends: the Keychron K8 Pro (tenkeyless, black) by default; presets after the K8 Pro in white, the Keychron K10 (full size), the Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and the Logitech MX Keys S; keys can be backlit.

items.name: desk-items
items.title: Desk items
items.description: A mouse after the Logitech MX Master 3S (or the Logitech Pebble Mouse 2, the Apple Magic Mouse, or the Razer DeathAdder V3), the Apple Magic Trackpad (white or black), the SteelSeries QcK XXL mat, an iPhone 16 Pro on a stand, a mug, a clock, a light bar, a globe lamp, figures and a plush.

items.name: mouse
items.title: Mouse
items.description: A mouse after the Logitech MX Master 3S by default, or the Logitech Pebble Mouse 2, the Apple Magic Mouse or the Razer DeathAdder V3 (`kind`).

items.name: trackpad
items.title: Trackpad
items.description: The Apple Magic Trackpad, white or black (`preset`).

items.name: phone
items.title: Phone
items.description: An iPhone 16 Pro at its published size.

items.name: tablet
items.title: Tablet
items.description: A tablet whose display is a named screen for screen(): the iPad Pro 11-inch (M4) by default, or the 13-inch; flat on the desk or standing on a stand, with the Apple Pencil Pro beside it.

items.name: audio
items.title: Microphone and speakers
items.description: A broadcast microphone sized like the Shure SM7B on a Rode PSA1+ boom arm, aimed at a mouth, and desktop speakers sized like the Audioengine A2+.

items.name: microphone
items.title: Microphone
items.description: A broadcast microphone sized like the Shure SM7B on a Rode PSA1+ boom arm.

items.name: speaker
items.title: Speaker
items.description: A desktop speaker sized like the Audioengine A2+.

items.name: chair
items.title: Office chair
items.description: A mesh office chair after the Herman Miller Aeron (size B): see-through seat and back, lumbar Y, curved arms, casters.

items.name: wall
items.title: Wall pieces
items.description: Shelves and storage sized like IKEA's LACK and KALLAX with bins, picture frames, a rug and a door.

items.name: kit-variants
items.title: Kit variants
items.description: Every variant of the kit in rows to look at: laptops, monitors, keyboards, mice, trackpads and tablets in their sizes and colours.

items.name: room
items.title: Room shell
items.description: A room's walls, window and blind, floor and ceiling, surfaces at their real tile size, and the named screens and prints a scenery draws on.

items.name: screen-shots
items.title: Screen shots
items.description: Moves that frame a screen's strip, detail or corner from in front, a side or below, sized from popular demos' frames.

items.name: home-desk
items.title: Home desk
items.description: The home desk setting, as the most watched mechanical-keyboard demos set it: a warm oak 1.6 m desk, a 27-inch monitor with a light bar and a Keychron Q2 Pro with Retro keycaps centred under it, a clock, a figure and a plant, in a room with a window on the left; four looks, the whole room or the desk alone, and an over-the-shoulder camera matched to a popular demo.

items.description: The whole home desk room at night: lamps, a violet light bar and an LED strip.

items.name: bedroom-desk
items.title: Bedroom desk
items.description: A pale pink desk in a bedroom corner beside the window, as pastel tablet videos set it: an iPad Pro 11 upright in portrait on an aluminium stand on a coiled rattan placemat, a globe lamp, a mug, and a framed print of Monet's Water Lilies (1906, public domain) over it; warm and soft. Four looks, the whole room or the desk alone, cameras on the tablet.
